details:
Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue change?
Choices:
A) A specific pipeline phase workflow (clarify, plan, implement, review/autofix, orchestrate, validate). Please name it. (RECOMMENDED)
B) A specific helper script or prompt under `scripts/` or `prompts/`. Please name the file.
C) Documentation only (README, docs/, or an agents.d fragment).
D) Something else. Please describe the component.
Q2: What kind of "better" do you want?
Choices:
A) Fix a specific bug or failure. Please link the failing run, log or error text. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Reduce cost or runtime, such as tokens, API calls or job duration. Please give the metric and the target.
C) Improve reliability or observability, such as retries, log prefixes or alerts.
D) Make docs or usability clearer.
Q3: How will we know it's done?
Choices:
A) A concrete, testable condition, such as a passing contract test, a metric threshold or a reproduction that no longer fails. Please state it. (RECOMMENDED)
B) A reviewer's judgment on the PR, with no objective criterion. Not recommended, because the result can't be verified.
